allowances.label: Real API Pricing
allowances.method: Tokens a month at full use of the plan, mostly measured from usage dashboards; dollar pools are converted at 97% cache reads, 2.5% fresh input and 0.5% output. Lower bounds: they assume you use the whole allowance.
